rows.ARS:
Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: JACpal
Exhibition name: Brigadoon ™
rows.Origin:
Bred by William A. Warriner (United States, 1991).
Introduced in United States by Jackson & Perkins Co. (post 1970) in 1992 as 'Brigadoon'.
rows.Class: Hybrid Tea. (Series: New Generation Roses ® Collection)
rows.Bloom: Coral - orange, cream reverse, ages to darker . Moderate, spice fragrance. 30 to 35 petals. Average diameter 5". Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered, reflexed bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Upright, well-branched. Large, semi-glossy, dark green, dense, leathery foliage.

Height: 3' (90cm). Width: 28" (70cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden. Vigorous. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
